memos.argument: Chapter 95 Note 1(e) excludes fancy dress of textiles from ch.95 into ch.61/62. Knit 100% polyester infant/toddler costumes are babies' garments; 6111.30 (synthetic fibers) then 6111.30.50 Other. Multiple CROSS rulings classify infant/toddler knit polyester costumes (coveralls, buntings, animal suits) in 6111.30.50.
exclusions_against: Ch.61 Note 2 excludes only 6212, worn clothing, orthopedic - nothing hurting
Sizing unconfirmed: 6111 requires babies (generally to 24 months, size 3T/toddler rulings split between 6111 and 6114/6104)
Toddler-size costumes in some rulings went to 6114.30 or 6104.43 instead

memos.argument: Costumes are festive/carnival/entertainment articles; CROSS places flimsy non-textile or 'dress up' sets in 9505.90.60.
exclusions_against: Ch.95 Note 1(e) expressly excludes fancy dress of textiles of ch.61 or 62 - directly defeats a knit polyester garment
Rulings place well-made knit costumes in ch.61; only flimsy-textile or accessory-type items reach 9505, and knit garment here is well made (unconfirmed)

memos.argument: If the costume is a one-piece coverall/jumpsuit-style of knit polyester, a track-suit-like reading under 6112.12 (synthetic) could be argued.
exclusions_against: 6112 is track suits, ski-suits, swimwear; costumes are not of that kind
Babies' garments go specifically to 6111 (more specific for infants); no cited ruling places infant costumes in 6112
